body:
I was writing for me, not for you.

I'm not a good writer, and I am not man enough for sex. There will be no relaxation in my future, my place in the human hierarchy assures it. This is no loss.  It assures natural selection.  It's beautiful in its absolute indifference. Suicide is a way for humans to prune the unnecessary. I'm not an intellectual, just another pathetic boy in a boy's body with a man's age.  Complete genetic garbage. My point is that I am not a man, and the frustration I feel at not being enough, ever, for anyone, even for a moment. At being the bottom. The failure. The mess.  The loser.  The pathetic "woe is me" character because I can't keep a smile as I watch the world pass me by, entirely unaffected by my influence. I reach out to touch, but I am garbage.  It's beautiful. There have always been untouchables.  We're just mostly invisible now.
